findings.evidence: media/glow-night-eye-level.png shows scattered stemmed flowers across the meadow.
findings.suggestion: Cluster the flowers in groups near trees and paths, cut the count, and either drop the stems or add the generated asset. Check the result in the real browser.
findings.what: Todo #79 asked for a generated glowing-mushroom asset, fewer and in clusters, with the same frame time. The author instead reshaped the flowers into petalled blooms: still 858 instances, scattered one by one on thin stems, and still the engine's primitive props. The result is less lollipop-like, but a sparse scatter of small stemmed flowers fills the night frame and there is no clustering near trees or paths. The todo was marked done on a reduced scope. The author's own note says the browser look is unchecked.

findings.evidence: The journal states 'one-off' errors, and the stack traces show frame! calling changed methods.
findings.suggestion: Keep #76 open until a game_crash or shutdown_request event has been seen in the log.
findings.what: Todos #56 and #77 (Revise world-age MethodErrors) were closed with 'nothing to fix'. They were seen once each, and the root cause is the known hot-reload hazard from engine edits. The author edited engine files (play.jl, render.jl) this session. A restart every ~6 min with no recorded cause (#76) is still open.

findings.evidence: Journal: 'the teleport-and-wait-3-frames checks are still timing-sensitive'.
findings.suggestion: Wait on a condition (position change or caught state) instead of a fixed frame count.

summary: Wild berry races now run again and the watching camera follows them; Firefly catch works at night (tester: 31/31, no failures). Frame median is 1.7 ms, p95 3.3 ms. The night flowers got better but the todo was only partly done.
